# Draft Rate Card (SW11/SW4 title, pre-launch)

Prices ex VAT. Anchor on reach and open rate; publish the card once the list passes
2,000 and opens are measured. Until then sell founding packages only.

## Founding partners (pre-launch to 2,000 subscribers)
| Package | What | Price | Slots |
|---|---|---|---|
| Founding Partner | Logo + line in every issue for 6 months, launch-issue feature, "brought to you by" on web archive and Instagram launch posts | £1,500 one-off | 3 (target: one BID, one estate agency, one hospitality group) |
| Launch Sponsor | Primary slot in 6 issues of choice within first 90 days | £600 | 6 |

## Standard inventory (from 2,000 subscribers; reprice at 5k and 10k)
| Slot | Format | Price per issue | Bundle |
|---|---|---|---|
| Presenting sponsor | Top banner line + 60-word native item with image, link tracked | £180 at 2k, £300 at 5k, £400 at 10k | 4 issues -10%, 12 issues -20% |
| Secondary | 40-word native item mid-issue | £90 / £150 / £200 | same |
| Events spotlight | Featured event card in Termine block + calendar listing | £40 / £60 / £80 | |
| Classifieds / Noticeboard | 25 words, text only | £25 / £35 / £45 | self-serve |
| Dedicated send | Whole issue to full list, max 2 per month | 2.3x presenting | |
| Featured directory listing | Pinned in category, photo, link, "verified" badge | £40 to £80 per month | annual -20% |
| Job posting | 30 days on site + one issue mention | £99 / £149 / £199 | |
| Instagram add-on | Story + feed card alongside the issue | +50% of slot | |

## Rules
- Max 2 paid native items per issue; always labelled "Partner" or "Sponsored".
- No category exclusivity below £5k/year.
- Monday report to every active sponsor: impressions (delivered), unique clicks, CTR vs issue average, next slot dates.
- Payment by card or invoice (Stripe); 14 days; founding packages up front.
